ios.desc:
HankyDoodle is a drawing and word-guessing game where you and your friends take turns sketching a word and guessing what the other person drew.

Every drawing is replayable. Watch your friend's brushstrokes appear in real time, share the replay as a video, or save the finished art to your photo library.

GAME MODES

- Word of the Day: a fresh word every 24 hours. Draw it your way and see how others interpreted the same prompt.
- Play with friends: send drawings back and forth, take your turn whenever you want, no live-game timer pressure.
- Random opponents: get matched with another HankyDoodle player and play one round at a time.
- Free draw: skip the games entirely and just draw. Save it, share it, or post it to the Showcase.

DRAWING TOOLS

Every tool, every color, all the time. No paywalls on drawing tools. An optional Premium subscription removes the banner ad and adds 32 superlikes a year, but it never gates a brush, a color, or a feature.

- Pencil with adjustable thickness
- Spray paint
- Line, rectangle, and ellipse shape tools
- Smart flood fill that handles imperfect closures
- Eraser, undo, and redo
- Full color picker

SHOWCASE

Browse community drawings from other HankyDoodle players, watch any drawing replay, and like the ones you love. Report or block content that isn't a fit; our moderators review every report within 24 hours.

PRIVACY

We don't track you across other apps or websites. Read the full privacy policy at https://hankydoodle.app/privacy.php for details on what we do collect (sign-in identifier, profile, drawings, friends, push tokens) and how long we keep it.

TERMS OF USE

By using HankyDoodle you agree to our Terms of Use at https://hankydoodle.app/terms.php, which cover account deletion, community rules, and the no-objectionable-content policy.

QUESTIONS

Email kyle@hankinsoft.com or open an issue at the support link below.

quotes.text:
Tech:

It's built with SwiftUI on iOS and Jetpack Compose on Android, both sitting on top of a shared C codec and renderer (also compiled to WebAssembly for the website). PHP/MySQL for the backend, and S3/CloudFront for storage.

Every new use starts with a game that includes one of my previous drawings. Yes, that's really me (I get lots of folks writing 'Are you an AI?'). Depending on what I'm up to, it may take me a bit to respond to drawings. I do store my drawings so I can re-send them to different users as I get LOTS of drawings per day and drawing a new one each time would leave me with no time left to work on anything else.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/hankydoodle/id6754983889
Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.hankinsoft.hankydoodle
